question: What was the population standard deviation of federal U.S. Government net outlays by function for the months in CY1981 in millions of nominal dollars (rounded to the nearest hundredths place)?
raw_response:
12 months (CY1981 Jan–Dec) from the "Net budget outlays" row of Table FFO-5. The population standard deviation is 6379.29 (in millions of nominal dollars).

The values: 59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698, 64216, 56838, 76875 — these are the "Net budget outlays" totals (net outlays summed across all functions) for each month, which is exactly "net U.S. Government net outlays by function."

<FINAL_ANSWER>6379.29</FINAL_ANSWER>
